significance.justification: A verified-true result would license the form-(iii) law that “the representation of a two-factor stimulus will be approximately the vector sum” for additive effects, while the residual’s direction and magnitude track true interactions and predict accuracy on unseen combinations; this fixes expected internal geometry and downstream generalization across whole families of factor pairs. It establishes both a representational phenomenon and correspondence to established composition mechanisms, though not a causal internal mechanism; this matters for the extrapolation problem operationalized by FLIP (Dallago et al., 2021) and ProteinGym (Notin et al., 2023), rather than merely showing that individual scientific concepts are decodable. True and false are distinguishable: a negative result would reject linear representational composition as a general diagnostic, although it would not rule out nonlinear mechanistic representations, so the negative branch is informative but narrower. Topic-substitution check: replacing the residual–interaction–generalization coupling with the generic topic would leave only an ordinary concept-probing hypothesis and would not merit this score.

reach.justification: The named handles are the “representation composition residual” and “Compositional-Fidelity Score,” explicitly proposed as a “read-only diagnostic of mechanistic understanding that predicts the model’s accuracy on unseen factor combinations.” This is ex ante at the model-audit level—benchmark compositional fidelity can inform whether to trust or select a model before relying on new combination predictions—although calculating pair-specific fidelity still depends on known single/combined scientific measurements. After per-model extraction, the hypothesis predicts a transferable relation—small residuals for additive effects, interaction-tracking residuals otherwise, and coupling to generalization—across protein, molecular, and materials models, so more than a search procedure survives recalibration and the downstream users include model auditors and scientific-model developers. Topic-substitution check: the broad scientific-representation topic alone supplies neither this diagnostic nor its advance-warning use, so the reach score comes from the claim-specific handle and predictive coupling.
